text_block_list.text: I mean~ zoos are classic for field trips, right? You can look at animals and help any lost kids find their group~ Then you can see the smiling faces of the kids, and it becomes a double treat♡

text_block_list.text: That’s not what I meant~ Actually, look over there, Kishi-kyun. Isn't that the real Kariza-kyun? It looks like he's gotten separated from the group. Oh well, guess we gotta go save him~
